fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232474/rates (2026 and 2027 seasons: STANDARD NONELECTRIC and RV NONELECTRIC $20 a night), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Reservation only, year-round, up to 6 months ahead; a site can also be booked on arrival through Recreation.gov or its call center (1-877-444-6777), but 'Payment is not accepted on site' and 'Walk-in sites and the cash/check drop box are no longer available.' 14 consecutive nights at most, 28 a year. A rig plus towed vehicle too long for one site must pay for two.

booking.source: https://www.nps.gov/gree/planyourvisit/campground.htm ('You must reserve your campsite online. Walk-in sites and the cash/check drop box are no longer available.') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232474 (notice: 'The campground offers year-round reservations. You may book 6 months in advance. Payment is not accepted on site. You must book your campsite in advance or upon arrival using the Recreation.gov website or call center'; facility_rules maxConsecutiveStay 14, maxStay 28 nights each year), read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: https://www.nps.gov/gree/planyourvisit/campground.htm ('There are no electrical or water hookups available.') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232474 ('There are no water or electrical hookups at the sites'), read 2026-10-21

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232474 ('The site contains flush toilets, drinking water, showers and a dump station.') + https://www.nps.gov/gree/planyourvisit/campground.htm ('There are hot showers, bathroom facilities and a dump station available to registered campers.'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: NPS: '174 campground sites'. 'RV limit is 30 feet (9 m) in B Loop and 35 feet (10.6 m) in D loop', including the tow vehicle; A Loop is for youth/organized groups only. About 84 sites in the recreation.gov catalog take RVs or trailers.

sites.source: https://www.nps.gov/gree/planyourvisit/campground.htm + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232474 (notice: 'RV limit is 30 feet (9 m) in B Loop and 35 feet (10.6 m) in D loop'; Overview: 'A Loop is a Scout loop, youth or group Loop only') + recreation.gov per-site catalog (trip_data/ridb_campsites.json, fetched 2026-10-20), read 2026-10-21

note: NPS (National Capital Parks-East), in Greenbelt MD just outside Washington DC, about 1.5 miles from the Greenbelt Metro station. Wooded loops with paved roads and parking spurs. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on NPS's campground page and recreation.gov: $20/night, reservation-only year-round 6 months ahead (bookable on arrival online, no walk-ups or cash), 14-night max; no hookups; flush toilets, hot showers, drinking water, dump; 174 sites, RVs to 30 ft (B Loop) / 35 ft (D Loop). Phone 771-208-1588 matches. No rec.gov minimum stay. Note trimmed of everything the fields now hold (site count, lengths, hookups, facilities, booking, waterfront).
